In [[geometry]], the '''heptagrammic-order heptagonal tiling''' is a [[List of regular polytopes#Hyperbolic tilings|regular]] star-tiling of the [[Hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]]. It has [[Schläfli symbol]] of {7,7/2}. The vertex figure [[heptagram]]s are {7/2}, [[File:Obtuse heptagram.svg|40px|class=skin-invert]]. The heptagonal faces overlap with [[Density (polytope)|density]] 3.

== Related tilings ==
It has the same [[vertex arrangement]] as the regular [[order-7 triangular tiling]], {3,7}. The full set of edges coincide with the edges of a [[heptakis heptagonal tiling]].
:[[File:Order-7 triangular tiling.svg|160px]][[File:Heptakis heptagonal tiling.svg|160px]]

It is related to a [[Kepler-Poinsot polyhedron]], the [[great dodecahedron]], {5,5/2}, which is polyhedron and a [[Density (polytope)|density]]-3 regular star-tiling on the sphere (resembling a regular icosahedron in this state, similarly to this tessellation resembling the order-7 triangular tiling):
:[[File:Great dodecahedron tiling.svg|240px]]
